exits.role: Executive Vice President, Worldwide Field Operations
exits.notes: Reason, as filed: he 'notified the Company of his intention to retire from his role effective upon the employment commencement date of his successor' and 'is expected to remain with the Company in a senior advisory role to ensure a seamless transition to his successor' (8-K, d201); Form 4: he 'retired from his role of Executive Vice President, Worldwide Field Operations effective August 24, 2026' (d203); the successor's start date is 2026-08-24 (d202). No filing through 2026-09-23 quantifies any exit pay: the 8-K gives no compensatory terms for him, no separation or advisory agreement has been filed (none in the 8-K or in the exhibit index of the 2026-08-26 10-Q), and the 2026 proxy says NVIDIA has no 'employment, severance, or change-in-control agreements with our executive officers' (d204). He remains an employee, so no filing says any equity accelerated; continued vesting while he advises is not quantified. The only figure available is the 2026 proxy's Potential Payments table: $103,423,060 for his 551,090 unvested RSUs/PSUs (d206), which is a change-in-control-only hypothetical (d205) and does not apply to a retirement, so it is NOT recorded as accelerated_equity_value. basis='estimated' because no actual amount is disclosed; every component and the total are null (not quantified). The first proxy after the departure (expected around May 2027) should show his FY2027 pay and any departure terms.

coverage.method: Director Compensation tables from every definitive proxy filed 2019-2026 (DEF 14A 2019-04-12, 2020-04-29, 2021-04-23, 2022-04-19, 2023-05-08, 2024-05-14, 2025-05-13, 2026-05-12), one table per fiscal year FY2019-FY2026: 97 rows (10, 11, 13, 12, 12, 13, 14, 12). Every table has only Fees Earned or Paid in Cash, Stock Awards and Total columns; the other columns are recorded as 0, and every row's cash + stock equals its printed total. Jen-Hsun Huang, the only employee director, is excluded by the proxies (no board pay). Checked with no director table: the 2022 'Notice of 2022 Annual Meeting' filed as form type DEF 14A (0001045810-22-000068) and the DEFA14A notices; no 10-K/A was filed in the period. The PRE 14As (2019-04-01, 2021-04-09, 2022-04-08, 2025-05-01) carry identical director tables and are not recorded.
